semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides high-purity fluid connectors and instrument valves essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Zhejiang Guanbo Fluid Technology Co., Ltd. is a specialized provider of high-purity fluid connectors and instrument valves, crucial for semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include a range of stainless steel fittings, valves, and couplings designed to meet the stringent requirements of semiconductor applications.
